what_this_is: The Voice lane's measured per-item runtimes, as rows a reader can check. `components/voice/app/backend/lane_contract.py` publishes these as `runtime_seconds`; it no longer carries a curated per-model table of its own.
admission_rule: A row is admitted only when the run itself left a stored probe receipt in this repository. Each `source` names that file and the field the number was read from, and `components/voice/app/tests/test_lane_contract.py` re-reads the file and fails if the two disagree. A wall-clock figure that survives only as a sentence (a comment, a changelog entry, a manifest's memory note) is not admitted: an absent runtime is honest, a curated one is the defect this record removes.
